clues.text: When Jesus fed five thousand, a boy offered five loaves made from it, along with two small fish.
A man from Baal-shalishah brought Elisha twenty loaves of this bread, and a hundred men ate with some left over.
Naomi and Ruth came back from Moab to Bethlehem just as the harvest of this grain began.
Arriving at the Midianite camp, Gideon heard a man's dream of a loaf of this bread knocking a tent flat.
When hail struck Egypt, this crop was destroyed because it was ripe, along with the flax that was in bloom.
Absalom had his servants set fire to Joab's field of this grain so Joab would come see him.
When the Lamb opened the third seal, a voice said three quarts of this grain would cost a denarius.
